checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: The final video lasts five seconds.
must.why: Frames sampled at 4.8 s of 5 s, so the clip is about 5 s.

must.item: Opening frame and footage match the first five seconds of the original clip.
must.why: The original is not available. The footage is consistent and is the same paper boat on water that was described.

must.item: Boat moves at original speed, no retiming or reordering.
must.why: The boat drifts slowly and smoothly across frames, with no sign of speed-up or reordering.

must.item: Ending is a simple cut, no fade or replacement shot.
must.why: The last frame at 4.8 s is the same shot at full brightness, with no fade.

must.item: Remains 16:9, silent and free of text.
must.why: The frames are 854x480 (16:9) and show no text. Silence cannot be checked from frames.

summary: A clean 5-second 16:9 clip of a white paper boat drifting on calm water, with no fade, no text and no visible artefacts, which matches what the user asked for.
